messages:
Emily Chen: Quick follow-up from the PM on last night's streaming partials/reconnects. I pulled a short list of action items and owners, trying to keep this tight so we can close in the next 2 weeks.

Jon K: TL;DR impact?

Emily Chen: ~2.4% of chat sessions saw a mid-stream silence for >5s, ~0.6% trimmed as partial responses. Most were during the 02:30-03:15 UTC window when a batch scheduler job rolled. No customer-facing errors logged but increased client reconnects.

Maya S: Noted. Is there a clear correlation to the scheduler window or a separate root cause?

Alan R: Initial traces point to a race between KV-cache eviction and continuous-batching flush. When eviction triggers during a batch flush we saw short stalls, which clients interpret as silence and try reconnecting.

sre-bot: Incident saved as INC-2026-319. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/streaming-partials (auto-tag: reconnect, partial-response)

Jon K: Proposed remediation items? Prioritize lowest-risk first.

Emily Chen: My proposal (from postmortem): 1) Client-side: smoother reconnect/backoff and dedupe on resumed sessions. 2) Server-side: make flush eviction atomic relative to batch pipeline. 3) Observability: add synthetic to detect mid-stream silence and alert at 0.5% for 10m.

Maya S: I'll take the observability piece. Will add a synthetic check and Grafana alert. Target: 2026-04-02.

Alan R: I'll handle the server-side change. Plan: add a short lock around KV eviction to avoid interleaving with flushes, plus add metrics to measure time spent in eviction. Implementation plan: PR -> canary on staging -> rollout to Dedicated. Target PR by 2026-03-30.

Alan R: Proposed reconnect config for clients (suggested to SDK):
```json
{"maxRetries":4, "initialBackoffMs":150, "maxBackoffMs":6000, "jitter":true}
```

Jon K: +1. Also suggest a dedupe window: client should accept resumed tokens up to 3s of overlap, drop duplicates.

Maya S: Obs details: will add a synthetic that streams an input for 60s and asserts no >3s pause. Will emit metric streaming.silence_rate and dashboard panel. Alert: streaming.silence_rate > 0.5 for 10m -> page SRE.

Emily Chen: Action item list (owners & dates):
- Maya S — synthetic + alert + dashboard — due 2026-04-02
- Alan R — KV eviction atomicity PR + metrics — due 2026-03-30
- Jon K — client SDK reconnect docs + dedupe logic spec — due 2026-03-28
- Emily Chen — coordinate canary, validate metrics, closure note — due 2026-04-06

ops-bot: Reminder set: follow-up meeting scheduled 2026-04-07 15:00 UTC.

Jon K: For the canary: suggestion to run a targeted traffic generator that simulates 1k concurrent streams for 10m while inducing eviction every ~30s. If silence_rate stays <0.3% we consider green.

Alan R: Agree. I'll add a small toggle to force eviction timing for the canary. Can we get SRE to run it during the maintenance window?

Maya S: SRE, pinged in #eng-sre, can we schedule? @sre-oncall ?

sre-bot: @oncall-sre notified.

Emily Chen: Risk rollbacks: If canary shows regressions, rollback by flipping kv-atomic-toggle=false and revert PR. Also client-side SDK change is opt-in for 1 release before default.

Jon K: One more medium-term item: add a server-side heuristic to proactively flush small idle batches (<N tokens) after X ms to avoid stalls when eviction strikes. Tentative owner: Alan R, timeline exploratory spike by 2026-04-09.

Maya S: I'll include a panel that breaks silence_rate by model, region, and deployment-type (Hosted/Dedicated/Private) so we can catch environment-specific patterns.

Emily Chen: Great. Let's track this in the incident ticket and the sprint board. I'll circulate a short closure checklist once all items are PR-merged and the canary is green.

Jon K: Thanks. If folks can drop short status updates here as they make progress that will help the closure note. :thumbsup:

Alan R: Starting work now — will post PR link when ready.

Maya S: Synthetic created, running in dev. Dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood/d/abcd/stream-silence (dev). Will promote to staging after test pass.

Emily Chen: Noted. Closing for now — meeting notes and owners are above. Will reopen thread if blockers come up.

Jon K: :eyes:

sre-bot: INC-2026-319 updated: Maya S added synthetic metric, Alan R opened PR #4521.

Emily Chen: Thanks everyone.
